description: This Zenodo dataset shares maintenance records for two ageing wind farms in Africa, deposited by Amr Elbanhawy in September 2026. The record read on 2026-09-28 describes the data only as relating to ageing wind farms with details on several subsystems, and holds two Excel files named Farm_Z1 and Farm_Z2 of about 0.5 MB each. Coverage is two wind farms in Africa; the farms are anonymised and their countries, turbine types and the period covered are not stated in the metadata read. The files are free under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: the spreadsheets were not opened, so the fields, such as failure dates, affected subsystems, downtime or repair actions, are unconfirmed, and there is no accompanying paper or data description. It supports reliability and resilience studies of wind generation, such as estimating subsystem failure rates and repair times of ageing turbines for availability models or maintenance planning. Related record: the wind turbine locations dataset for South Africa.
